lines.zh: 黑白斑驳的身子，在草里一晃一晃。
lines.en: Black and white patches bob through the grass.

lines.zh: 我沿着田埂走，鼻子一路拱。
lines.en: I walk the field ridge, snout rooting all the way.
These patches never tan evenly.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩进泥里，拔出来有声。
lines.en: My hooves sink in mud and come out with a sound.

lines.zh: 从地球版走过来，路还是这条路。
lines.en: I came over from Earth; the road is still a road.

lines.zh: 我走走停停，闻闻每株草根。
lines.en: I stop and go, sniffing every grass root.

lines.zh: 花斑在草影里很难看清。
lines.en: In dappled shade my patches blur.

lines.zh: 我肚子有点晃，走得就慢。
lines.en: My belly sways, so I go slowly.

lines.zh: 我贴着木栏走，鼻子一路刮。
lines.en: I walk the fence line, nose scraping along it.
This soil is soft — good for rooting.

lines.zh: 一黑一白，像两块田拼起来。
lines.en: One black, one white, like two fields stitched.

lines.zh: 我绕过水坑，泥里不好走。
lines.en: I go around the puddle; mud is bad footing.
I stand, tail flicking.

lines.zh: 鼻子还在动，找能吃的东西。
lines.en: My snout keeps moving, searching for something edible.
A fly lands on my patch.

lines.zh: 花斑那块被晒得发烫，我挪开。
lines.en: The pale patch gets hot, so I shift away.

lines.zh: 太阳晒到白的那块，发烫。
lines.en: The sun heats the white patch more.
Half-closed eyes; I am close to sleep.

lines.zh: 这片草地属于我，随便站。
lines.en: This meadow is mine; I stand where I like.

lines.zh: 我左耳动了一下，听见虫。
lines.en: My left ear twitches; I hear a bug.

lines.zh: 鼻子拱开土，露出一条根。
lines.en: My snout turns up a root.
Doing nothing suits me.

lines.zh: 花斑猪在平原上很常见。
lines.en: Piebald pigs are common on the plains.
I lift a hoof, then set it down.
Wind from behind; my tail blocks it.
I doze on my feet for a while.
Dried mud on my legs is uncomfortable.
A companion grunts somewhere off.

lines.zh: 我拱开一块土，找底下的根。
lines.en: I root up a patch of soil for the roots beneath.
This grass is enough for a whole day of standing.

lines.zh: 你掌心要是甜的，我就凑过去。
lines.en: If your palm is sweet, I'll come nosing over.
I look up, snout moving first.

lines.zh: 我这身花斑，你觉得好看吗。
lines.en: Do you like my patches?

lines.zh: 你从地球那边来的？我也。
lines.en: From Earth too? So am I.
Do not stand in front of my trough.
I tilt my head at your boots.
You smell of a pigpen.
Two grunts, as a greeting.
If you stay still, I go back to eating.
I rub once against your leg.

lines.zh: 你的影子凉快，我站进去。
lines.en: Your shadow is cool; I step into it.
Looking up is hard with a neck this short.
My squeal is loud and ugly.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我鼻子撞疼了。
lines.en: That hurt my snout.
I bolt aside, then stop.
Ten health — do not strike again.
Blood on my patches.

lines.zh: 膝盖磕在石头上，我哼了一声。
lines.en: My knee knocks on stone and I squeal.
I pant hard, ribs heaving.
This wound keeps me from running.

lines.zh: 我挤出两声哼叫，往同伴中间钻。
lines.en: I squeeze out two squeals and burrow into the herd.
The pain makes me grunt and grunt.

lines.zh: 甜味一飘，我四只蹄都挪不动。
lines.en: One sweet whiff and all four hooves lock up.
You are holding the carrot too high.
I push forward; my snout arrives first.
Give it to me and I will do anything.
Set it down; do not tease me.
I smell sweetness and cannot walk on.
One bite is all I ask.
Do not back away; I cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜一递近，我鼻子就贴上。
lines.en: The carrot comes close and my snout is on it.

lines.zh: 这块地我记住了，明天还来。
lines.en: I will remember this spot and come back tomorrow.
Bump me; I stay put.
Mind your step; I am wider than you.

lines.zh: 泥蹭上花斑，我甩了甩身子。
lines.en: Mud smears my patches; I shake myself.
Mud splashes up from your step.
Do not step on my tail tip.
I am nudged half a step off.

lines.zh: 我们别挤在同一个槽前。
lines.en: Let us not crowd the same trough.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把我鼻子撞歪了。
lines.en: That knocked my snout sideways.
We pressed the grass flat between us.
I step back because I am lazy, not scared.

lines.zh: 我哼哼着凑过去，她没躲。
lines.en: I grunt my way closer and she doesn't shy.

lines.zh: 同类难找，平原上还有几只。
lines.en: Kin are scarce, but a few roam these plains.
I grunt softly so I do not scare her off.

lines.zh: 泥里打滚，是最好看的打扮。
lines.en: A roll in the mud is the finest attire.
We root side by side, saying nothing.

lines.zh: 这个季节，猪圈里很热闹。
lines.en: This season the pen gets lively.

lines.zh: 我鼻子碰鼻子，就算说定了。
lines.en: Nose to nose, and it is agreed.
Do not watch; I get shy.
Her patches are prettier than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起走回草地深处。
lines.en: We walk back into the deeper grass.
I pick up a beetroot.
This fruit fell; it is mine.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，走两步又放下。
lines.en: I carry it two steps and drop it.

lines.zh: 鼻子顶住它，我一步一步拱。
lines.en: Nose under it, I shove it along step by step.
In mud, I sniff first.
A seed — too small to taste.

lines.zh: 我拱了半天，它还是埋在土里。
lines.en: I root and root, but it stays buried.
Not food; I put it down.
I hide it in the hay.
I'll hold on to it and taste it later.
Something moved in the grass.
I stare at that patch of ground.
Someone stepped on my meadow.
I am not fierce, only wary.
I put myself in front of the trough.

lines.zh: 我压低鼻子，蹄子刨了两下。
lines.en: I drop my snout and paw the ground twice.
That sound is not a companion.
I grunt low in my throat.
If it comes, I will back off.
Now I see it: a fox.

lines.zh: 我一直看着它，不吃草了。
lines.en: I keep watching it and stop grazing.

lines.zh: 我不吃草了，只盯着它露头。
lines.en: I quit the grass and watch for it to show itself.
I lower my snout to listen through the earth.
It backed off; I am still uneasy.
Two grunts as a warning.
I edge toward my companions.

lines.zh: 这地方没有栅栏可以躲。
lines.en: There is no fence to hide behind.

lines.zh: 我的花斑在暗处不明显。
lines.en: My patches are hard to see in shadow.
One more step from it and I run.

lines.zh: 我慢慢退到草深的地方。
lines.en: I back slowly into the tall grass.
I shove once, lightly.
I have no tusks, only a snout.
This shove is to make you step back.
I open my mouth and bite your sleeve.
This strength will not topple you.
My hoof scrapes the soil once.
Do not make me shove twice.
One hit, and I run for the grass.
After the shove I wobble myself.

lines.zh: 我顶完就退，蹄子在泥里打滑。
lines.en: I butt and back off, hooves slipping in mud.
I open my eyes on the plains.
My patches are still wet.

lines.zh: 我睁眼的时候，鼻子里全是土味。
lines.en: I open my eyes to a nose full of earth.
I try to stand; my legs slip.
The smell of soil is more familiar than milk.
I root the soil for the first time.

lines.zh: 风把我的毛吹得倒向一边。
lines.en: The wind lays my hair to one side.
This place is much like Earth.
A companion is already beside me.
One grunt: I am here.
I choose this meadow as home.
The sky is huge and the grass is short.

lines.zh: 我的毛烧起来，味道很难闻。
lines.en: My hair catches fire; the smell is awful.
I land with all four hooves in the air.

lines.zh: 水进了鼻子，我拼命往上顶。
lines.en: Water fills my snout; I push upward hard.
The blast throws me against the fence.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在我的花斑上。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my patch.

lines.zh: 一股麻劲钻进鼻子，我直打颤。
lines.en: A numb crawl runs up my snout and I shiver.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我连拱土都没劲。
lines.en: Empty belly; I cannot even root.

lines.zh: 雷太响，我整只猪都僵了。
lines.en: The thunder is too loud; my whole body stiffens.
No ground; I am falling.
